items.html: And this is what is said in Parashat Bereishit: "When Abraham came, the created [Bara] returned to become a member [Ever], and this member was revealed." And the matter is that through the influence received in Abraham, which is the Hochma of ZA, which is the secret of the first Hesed, from this the member of Yesod is corrected and is revealed in ZA. And since through this Yesod ZA couples with the Malchut called MA, therefore Abraham is called "Ever MA" [the member of MA], for he causes the joining of Yesod with Malchut.
